heldout_preregistration.expected_concepts: d6 attacks the central pawn and prepares development while affecting Nd3 and its choice of recapture. Bb4 changes exchange and queen/bishop continuation. Actual engine pair and replies decide claims; no book line or comparison move is forced.
heldout_preregistration.history: standalone diagram FEN, neither side has castling rights, neutral halfmove clock

implementation: Initial-check roots are admitted only after legal capture of checker, king move, or interposition is certified and the resulting king is no longer checked. Both actual choices keep this obligation.
The shared reply activity pool includes the first opposing reply and its exchange-enabled use. Own activity can no longer displace a materially earlier opposing use by surviving longer.

Reply comparison starts at the strongest actual returned reply and selects the next distinct activity with an owned comparison; separated quality is explicitly stated rather than treated as equivalence.
Opposing activity is not attached as the original mover's own purpose. Independent screen validation checks original side, route, actual controller removal/blocking and scope.
Identical physical activity through an exact shared move/position prefix can be referred to once, while both owned costs and receipts remain.

remaining_common_bottlenecks.finding: The earliest attack/capture wins even when its original actor disappears in that same local exchange. The independent dxe5 attacking d4 is such a transient contact. An attack also satisfies purposeKnown and can prevent a later use extending the root account.
remaining_common_bottlenecks.preserve: Do not simply prioritize surviving or later pieces: prior Qa4 deliberately preserves an early purpose that is realized and exchanged.

remaining_common_bottlenecks.finding: A corridor must remain empty from immediately after the root move to the later use. In the actual d6 lines, the same d-pawn first remains on d6, then leaves by dxe5 and is exchanged, while the original d5 bishop later vacates d5; only then Qd5 uses the route. A sequence of physically certified prerequisites is not represented by the current single-clearance condition.
remaining_common_bottlenecks.boundary: Keep all intermediate constraints, responses and material costs; do not weaken continuity to borrow an arbitrary distant PV fact.

remaining_common_bottlenecks.finding: Quiet defensive reply activity such as Nd3 followed by a recapture, and multi-step preparation absent from the returned PV, remain incompletely discovered. Immediate obligations and target facts alone are not full purpose discovery.
